evidence.text: 1. Evaluate queue libraries for the notification service Owner: Priya. Status: in progress. Started 3 Nov. Notes: Compared BullMQ and a Postgres-backed queue. Postgres option wins on operational simplicity; BullMQ wins on throughput. Waiting on load numbers from staging before we pick one.

2. Why did checkout latency spike in October? Owner: Tomas. Status: finished. Closed 28 Oct. Notes: Root cause was an unindexed join introduced in the coupon rewrite. Index added, p95 back to 310 ms. Write-up is in the wiki.

3. Can we drop support for the legacy mobile API? Owner: Lena. Status: closed. Closed 9 Nov, decision: not yet. Notes: 11 percent of active devices still call v1. Revisit after the March forced-update release.

4. Accessibility audit of the onboarding flow Owner: Priya. Status: in progress. Started 10 Nov. Notes: Screen reader pass done on web. Android and iOS still to do. Three blocking issues found so far, all in the address form.
